The Motoring Show - Affiliate Program Overview

Brand Introduction
The Motoring Show is an already established instagram community with 70.3k followers. We offer affiliates: a premade catalogue with tried and tested products, an already interested community, a niche whose target audience is easy to identify and video + picture packs for you to use for promotion.

Product Description
Our platform offers a wide array of content and experiences, including:

  • Latest Car News: Breaking updates on new releases, automotive technology, and industry trends.
  • Competitions: Exciting opportunities for our audience to win exclusive car-related prizes.
  • Events: Unforgettable gatherings for car enthusiasts, from showcases to interactive meetups.
  • Website Content: Expert reviews, insights, and engaging articles to keep our audience informed and inspired.

Unique Selling Point (USP)
The Motoring Show combines cutting-edge content, a highly engaged community, and exclusive events to create a one-of-a-kind experience for automotive enthusiasts. Our platform’s dynamic reach and reputation in the motoring industry make it an ideal partner for affiliates seeking to connect with a passionate audience and sell our range of high quality, motoring products.

Payment Terms
We offer competitive commission rates on all referred sales and sign-ups. Payment terms are transparent, with payouts processed on a monthly basis via secure methods such as bank transfer or PayPal. Custom terms can be negotiated for top-performing affiliates.

Other Information

  • Support: Affiliates receive dedicated support, including marketing resources and analytics to optimize performance.
  • Tracking: State-of-the-art tracking systems ensure accurate attribution of referrals.
  • Flexibility: Work with us to create customized campaigns tailored to your audience and goals.

Join The Motoring Show’s affiliate program today and drive your success with one of the automotive industry’s most exciting brands!
